decision.summary: A large, multi-axis discontinuity begins ~600: U drops sharply (~−15 MAD) and stays depressed through ~629, with only partial rebound starting at 630 (within allowed context but not completed). N shows a delayed +3 MAD step (~605–610) that persists. E displays complex, non-monotonic behavior without a clear opposing return. No axis exhibits a fully closed temporary offset with confirmed onset, sustained interior, and opposing return within [560,670]. The candidate jumps at 593, 601, and 625 reflect parts of this overlapping event but do not define independent intervals. All proposed temporary offsets remain uncertain due to incomplete returns.

intervals.observation: U drops sharply ~600–602 (≈−15 MAD), remains depressed until ~629; N shows delayed step up ~605–610 (+3 MAD); E exhibits non-monotonic fluctuation without clear opposing return. Return in U begins at ~630 but is incomplete within allowed context (ends at 670). No full opposing return observed for U or N; E shows partial recovery but not to pre-event level. Status: uncertain due to unobserved/ambiguous return.

E shows a transient dip and rebound centered ~600–615, but lacks a clean onset-return pair; superposed with U drop and N step. No isolated, self-contained temporary offset identifiable on E alone. Candidate jump at 601 is part of broader multi-axis event, not a standalone interval. No confirmed temporary offset on E.
